name: DeepSeek-Reasonix
description: DeepSeek-native AI coding agent for your terminal. Engineered around prefix-cache stability — leave it running.
readmeExcerpt:
English  ·  简体中文  ·  Guide  ·  ACP  ·  Extensions  ·  Spec  ·  Website  ·  Discord


Open source · MIT · a single Go binary

A coding agent you can leave running.

One local engine, four ways in — terminal, desktop app, browser, or your editor over ACP. Plan mode, permissions, a workspace sandbox and per-turn checkpoints keep a long autonomous run something you can still read and undo.


> [!IMPORTANT] > **Community · 加入社区** — bilingual Discord for setup help (`#help` / `#求助`), workflow showcases, and feature ideas. → ****
## Features - **Config-driven.** Providers, the agent, enabled tools, and plugins are all declared in `reasonix.toml`. No hardcoded models. - **Multi-model & composable.** DeepSeek ships as a preset; any OpenAI-compatible endpoint is a config entry, not new code. Optionally run two models together (executor + planner) in separate, cache-stable sessions. - **Plugin-driven.** MCP servers contribute tools, prompts, and resources; Extension Protocol v1 sidecars can also intercept runtime events, contribute Providers and structured UI, and ship versioned plugin packages. - **Cache-aware context maintenance.** Startup injects a small stable environment summary, stale tool output is snipped/pruned before summary compaction, and the built-in tool schema contract is documented for regression review. - **Zero-friction distribution.** `CGO_ENABLED=0` single binary; cross-compile to six targets with one command. The result is a fully self-contained static binary — nothing to install on the target machine beyond the binary itself. ## Install Choose the path that matches how you want to use Reasonix. The CLI/TUI, desktop app, and VS Code extension all use the same local Reasonix engine. ### Path A: CLI / TUI Install the native binary through npm on any supported platform, or use Homebrew on macOS: ```sh npm i -g reasonix # any OS; pulls the prebuilt native binary brew install esengine/reasonix/reasonix # macOS ``` Prebuilt archives (`darwin|linux|windows × amd64|arm64`) and `SHA256SUMS` are on every [GitHub release](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/releases). ### Path B: Desktop app Use the [official download page](https://reasonix.io/?download=desktop#start) for the latest desktop build. | Platform | Package | Architecture | | --- | --- | --- | | macOS | Universal `.dmg` or `.zip` | Apple Silicon / Intel | | Windows | Installer `.exe` or portable `.zip` | x64 / ARM64 | | Linux | `.deb` or `.tar.gz` | x64 | Windows installers are code-signed through [SignPath.io](https://signpath.io/) with a free certificate provided by the [SignPath Foundation](https://signpath.org/). ### Path C: VS Code extension Complete Path A first. The extension does not bundle the CLI; it starts your local `reasonix acp` backend and adds native chat, editor context, tool-call approvals, model selection, and workspace sessions. - **VS Code:** [install from Visual Studio Marketplace](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/items?itemName=SivanLiu.reasonix-agent) - **VSCodium / Eclipse Theia:** [install from Open VSX Registry](https://open-vsx.org/extension/SivanLiu/reasonix-agent) - **Extension ID:** `SivanLiu.reasonix-agent` · [source and usage guide](https://github.com/SivanCola/reasonix-vscode) ### Path D: Build from source Clone the repository first: ```sh git clone https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix.git cd DeepSeek-Reasonix ``` #### CLI The CLI build requires **Go 1.25+**. The module pins a `toolchain` directive; keep `GOTOOLCHAIN=auto` so Go downloads the pinned toolchain, or install it. ```sh make build # -> bin/reasonix(.exe) make cross # -> dist/ (darwin|linux|windows × amd64|arm64) ``` #### Desktop The desktop build additionally requires: - **Node 24+ and pnpm 10** (`npm install -g pnpm@10`) for the frontend - **Wails CLI** matching the shared `.wails-version` pin ```sh make wails-install cd desktop wails build ``` See the [desktop build guide](desktop/README.md#prerequisites) for platform webview dependencies and Linux build tags. ## Quick start ### CLI / TUI These commands are for the CLI/TUI installed through Path A: ```sh reasonix setup # configure a provider and model reasonix # start an interactive session reasonix run "implement the TODOs in main.go" ``` In an interactive session, run `/init` when you want Reasonix to create project instructions. ### Desktop app Download the installer for your platform from the [official download page](https://reasonix.io/?download=desktop#start), install and launch Reasonix, then configure a provider and model in the app. The CLI commands above are not required for the desktop app. For advanced CLI usage and configuration, see the **[CLI reference](./docs/CLI.md)**, **[Guide](./docs/GUIDE.md)**, and **[configuration paths](./docs/CONFIG_PATHS.md)**. ## Documentation - **Getting started:** [Guide](./docs/GUIDE.md) · [CLI reference](./docs/CLI.md) · [Configuration paths](./docs/CONFIG_PATHS.md) · [ACP editor integration](./docs/ACP.md) - **Features & troubleshooting:** [Subagent profiles](./docs/SUBAGENT_PROFILES.md) · [Context Engine v2](./docs/SESSION_MEMORY_RETRIEVAL.md) · [Capability diagnostics](./docs/CAPABILITY_DIAGNOSTICS.md) · [Recovery and updates](./docs/RECOVERY.md) · [Bot guide](./docs/BOT_GUIDE.md) · [Checkpoints & rewind](./docs/CHECKPOINTS.md) - **Engineering & migration:** [Spec](./docs/SPEC.md) · [Task contracts & pause policy](./docs/TASK_CONTRACT.md) · [Tool contract](./docs/TOOL_CONTRACT.md) · [Migrating from 0.x](./docs/MIGRATING.md) - **Extension development:** [Extensions](./docs/EXTENSIONS.md) · [Plugin packages and Manifest v1](./docs/PLUGIN_PACKAGES.md) · [Extension Protocol](./docs/EXTENSION_PROTOCOL.md) · [Go SDK and starter](./sdk/go/README.md) ## Star History
## Acknowledgments A small list of folks whose work has shaped Reasonix the most — the current top 20 contributors by commit count. The full contributor graph is on [GitHub](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/graphs/contributors?all=1). | Contributor | Contributor | Contributor | Contributor | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | [**SivanCola**](https://github.com/SivanCola) | [**esengine**](https://github.com/esengine) | [**ttmouse**](https://github.com/ttmouse) | [**lifu963**](https://github.com/lifu963) | | **reasonix** | [**HUQIANTAO**](https://github.com/HUQIANTAO) | [**GTC2080**](https://github.com/GTC2080) | [**light-front-theory**](https://github.com/light-front-theory) | | **merge-order-check** | [**Li-Charles-One**](https://github.com/Li-Charles-One) | [**eghrhegpe**](https://github.com/eghrhegpe) | **wufengfan** | | [**CVEngineer66**](https://github.com/CVEngineer66) | [**dependabot\[bot\]**](https://github.com/apps/dependabot) | [**lanshi17**](https://github.com/lanshi17) | [**SuMuxi66**](https://github.com/SuMuxi66) | | [**CnsMaple**](https://github.com/CnsMaple) | [**cyq1017**](https://github.com/cyq1017) | [**JesonChou**](https://github.com/JesonChou) | [**XTLine**](https://github.com/XTLine) | Special thanks to [**Bernardxu123**](https://github.com/Bernardxu123) for designing the project logo and intro video.

English  ·  简体中文  ·  Guide  ·  ACP  ·  Extensions  ·  Spec  ·  Website  ·  Discord


Open source · MIT · a single Go binary

A coding agent you can leave running.

One local engine, four ways in — terminal, desktop app, browser, or your editor over ACP. Plan mode, permissions, a workspace sandbox and per-turn checkpoints keep a long autonomous run something you can still read and undo.

logo-animation.mp4

Important

Community · 加入社区 — bilingual Discord for setup help (#help / #求助), workflow showcases, and feature ideas. → https://discord.gg/XF78rEME2D


Features

  • Config-driven. Providers, the agent, enabled tools, and plugins are all declared in reasonix.toml. No hardcoded models.
  • Multi-model & composable. DeepSeek ships as a preset; any OpenAI-compatible endpoint is a config entry, not new code. Optionally run two models together (executor + planner) in separate, cache-stable sessions.
  • Plugin-driven. MCP servers contribute tools, prompts, and resources; Extension Protocol v1 sidecars can also intercept runtime events, contribute Providers and structured UI, and ship versioned plugin packages.
  • Cache-aware context maintenance. Startup injects a small stable environment summary, stale tool output is snipped/pruned before summary compaction, and the built-in tool schema contract is documented for regression review.
  • Zero-friction distribution. CGO_ENABLED=0 single binary; cross-compile to six targets with one command. The result is a fully self-contained static binary — nothing to install on the target machine beyond the binary itself.

Install

Choose the path that matches how you want to use Reasonix. The CLI/TUI, desktop app, and VS Code extension all use the same local Reasonix engine.

Path A: CLI / TUI

Install the native binary through npm on any supported platform, or use Homebrew on macOS:

npm i -g reasonix                  # any OS; pulls the prebuilt native binary
brew install esengine/reasonix/reasonix   # macOS

Prebuilt archives (darwin|linux|windows × amd64|arm64) and SHA256SUMS are on every GitHub release.

Path B: Desktop app

Use the official download page for the latest desktop build.

Platform Package Architecture
macOS Universal .dmg or .zip Apple Silicon / Intel
Windows Installer .exe or portable .zip x64 / ARM64
Linux .deb or .tar.gz x64

Windows installers are code-signed through SignPath.io with a free certificate provided by the SignPath Foundation.

Path C: VS Code extension

Complete Path A first. The extension does not bundle the CLI; it starts your local reasonix acp backend and adds native chat, editor context, tool-call approvals, model selection, and workspace sessions.

  • VS Code: install from Visual Studio Marketplace
  • VSCodium / Eclipse Theia: install from Open VSX Registry
  • Extension ID: SivanLiu.reasonix-agent · source and usage guide

Path D: Build from source

Clone the repository first:

git clone https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix.git
cd DeepSeek-Reasonix

CLI

The CLI build requires Go 1.25+. The module pins a toolchain directive; keep GOTOOLCHAIN=auto so Go downloads the pinned toolchain, or install it.

make build      # -> bin/reasonix(.exe)
make cross      # -> dist/ (darwin|linux|windows × amd64|arm64)

Desktop

The desktop build additionally requires:

  • Node 24+ and pnpm 10 (npm install -g pnpm@10) for the frontend
  • Wails CLI matching the shared .wails-version pin
make wails-install
cd desktop
wails build

See the desktop build guide for platform webview dependencies and Linux build tags.

Quick start

CLI / TUI

These commands are for the CLI/TUI installed through Path A:

reasonix setup                      # configure a provider and model
reasonix                            # start an interactive session
reasonix run "implement the TODOs in main.go"

In an interactive session, run /init when you want Reasonix to create project instructions.

Desktop app

Download the installer for your platform from the official download page, install and launch Reasonix, then configure a provider and model in the app. The CLI commands above are not required for the desktop app.

For advanced CLI usage and configuration, see the CLI reference, Guide, and configuration paths.

Documentation

  • Getting started: Guide · CLI reference · Configuration paths · ACP editor integration
  • Features & troubleshooting: Subagent profiles · Context Engine v2 · Capability diagnostics · Recovery and updates · Bot guide · Checkpoints & rewind
  • Engineering & migration: Spec · Task contracts & pause policy · Tool contract · Migrating from 0.x
  • Extension development: Extensions · Plugin packages and Manifest v1 · Extension Protocol · Go SDK and starter

releases.name: Reasonix CLI v1.31.4
releases.body:
> 此版本修复了多个桌面端问题，包括损坏的会话元数据恢复、后台任务通知、模型服务删除和会话滚动。同时通过移除高成本的指标汇总提升了性能。

**发布渠道：稳定版 · v1.31.4**

[English →](https://reasonix.io/changelog/v1.31.4/?lang=en) · [网页版完整更新日志 →](https://reasonix.io/changelog/v1.31.4/)

## 使用攻略

- [**目标执行指南**](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/blob/aa3688814852ebae0835ca07731ee929fbd35c7e/docs/GOAL_ENFORCEMENT.zh-CN.md) — 了解 Reasonix 中目标执行的工作原理。
- [**用户指南**](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/blob/aa3688814852ebae0835ca07731ee929fbd35c7e/docs/GUIDE.md) — 使用 Reasonix 的综合指南。
- [**用户指南（中文）**](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/blob/aa3688814852ebae0835ca07731ee929fbd35c7e/docs/GUIDE.zh-CN.md) — 使用 Reasonix 的中文综合指南。

## 概览

**Reasonix v1.31.4 — 桌面端稳定性与性能改进**

此版本修复了多个桌面端问题，包括损坏的会话元数据恢复、后台任务通知、模型服务删除和会话滚动。同时通过移除高成本的指标汇总提升了性能。

发布日期：2026-08-25

## 重点内容

- **从损坏的会话元数据中恢复** — 元数据文件全零或仅含空白的会话现在会自动重建，不再阻止保存和关闭标签页。 ([#9155](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/9155))
- **更清晰的后台任务通知** — 安静运行的后台任务不再被报告为“卡住”；通知现在说明任务仍在运行，并解释如何调整警告阈值。 ([#9115](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/9115))
- **删除已配置的默认模型服务** — 现在即使模型服务是当前默认值，也可以删除已配置的自定义服务；后端会安全地重新定向引用。 ([#9344](https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/9

releases.name: Reasonix Studio v2.7.0
releases.body:
委派这一版从一张清单变成一张图：谁在等谁、谁在排队等名额、哪一步是真跑过的，都画了出来，点一个节点就落到它对应的那次调用上。待发队列也换成了内核持有的那一份。自 2.6.0 起 23 个提交。

## 新增

**运行图**

- 此前面板只能数出「四个子代理在跑」，说不出其中哪个在等哪个——因为它拿到的那份清单早就把结构丢掉了：`depends_on` 活在一次 Execute 调用里，从没离开过进程；落盘的 sidecar 只记了一条父子链接；事件流靠 id 前缀暗示其余部分。结构现在由内核发布（`internal/agentgraph`），不再由前端从形状上猜。
- 一列就是一个秩：里面的节点在那一刻都可以跑。宽度是并发、长度是链条——这正是清单渲染不出来的区别。
- 边按线型区分而不是颜色：实线实心箭头表示上游的答案进了下游的上下文；虚线空心箭头表示只排了先后、什么都没传。消融测量臂产出的正是后者，两种画成一样就等于说这两次运行是同一次。复用是节点上的标记，因为被采纳的条目根本没跑。状态在卡片上是一个词，不只是一个颜色。
- 排版不再只有秩。此前节点在列里的行号由增量到达顺序决定，连线毫无理由地交叉，跨列的边直接压过中间的卡片，同一次运行重画一遍还不一样。现在补上了 Sugiyama 缺的两步：按邻列行号中位数扫排（只保留让交叉数下降的那一轮），长边在它跨越的每一秩预留一条细行，于是它从卡片之间穿过而不是压上去。列按最高的一列居中，而不是从顶端吊下来——孤零零一个节点此前读起来像「跑得早」，其实是「只有它」。
- 点一个节点就跳到那次调用本身：它的参数、输出、周围的推理。此前只有用户消息在 DOM 里带锚点，因为只有回退轨需要找东西。工具卡片现在带上图里称呼它的那个 id，嵌套的子调用也带——扇出的节点实际就住在那儿。

**一个节点会说它什么时候跑的、在等什么**

- 图上早就声明了 `StartedAt` / `EndedAt`，却从来没有生产者填过，于是每个消费者的时间回退分支都是死代码，一次运行的先后只剩下「增量碰巧按什么顺序发布」。
- 「在等名额」和「拿到名额」此前是同一个词。被会话并发上限限流的扇出，和所有条目同时开跑的扇出，画出来一模一样——而这两者的区别，正好决定把上限调高有没有用。现在 `StateQueued` 与 `QueuedAt` 分开，详情条上「等名额」和「实际运行」并排。
- 一个条目在它自己结束的那一刻就结束，而不是等整组结束。长扇出此前会把每个跑完的 worker 一直画成还在跑，直到最慢的兄弟返回——那正是有人在盯着看的全部时间。

**待发队列面板**

- Studio 早就能在一轮进行中插话，但看不见队列：屏幕上那些待发行是客户端自己造的，只说明「这个窗口发过什么」。刷新一下就没了，而条目还在清单里，仍然

releases.name: Reasonix Studio v2.6.0
releases.body:
窗口这一版被整备成一台仪器：灰阶回到产品自己的色相，活动流成为一条可扫读的执行轨，菜单栏有了状态图标。自 2.5.0 起 25 个提交。

## 破坏性变更

- **关闭按钮不再总是退出**。`[desktop] close_behavior` 早就可配置、可迁移、可编辑，却没有任何代码读它——`quit|background` 是一个没有兑现的承诺。现在有状态图标时，关闭把窗口收起，图标把它带回来；没有图标时仍然直接退出，因为一个消失了又找不回来的窗口是两者中最坏的结果。要保持旧行为，把 `close_behavior` 设为 `quit`，或用 `tray = "off"` 关掉图标。

## 新增

**状态图标**（菜单栏 / 任务栏）

- 图标说明这台机器上正在发生什么：几轮在等你、几轮在跑、几个后台任务还活着。后台任务是没人会猜到的那一半——一个收起的窗口里跑着 dev server，仍然在替你占着这台机器。
- 菜单可以唤回窗口、就地切换关闭行为、退出。文案跟随机器的语言。
- `tray = "auto"|"off"`（设置 › 桌面）。

**活动流成为执行轨**

- 左侧那条竖线加粗到 2px，并按类别上色——读是中性、写是琥珀、联网是蓝、委派是青。时间线的结构一直写在那里，只是 1px 的浅灰在屏幕上等于不存在。子代理面板里的子步保持窄沟槽，两级同宽就分不出层。
- 终端输出与 diff 凹进去一档，成为一块面板。此前它们是全屏最占地方的元素，却直接贴在白底上。
- 等你批准的那张卡从流里浮起来，带一层琥珀底；答复过就撤掉。琥珀在这套配色里只说一件事——需要你——而它此前只到按钮为止。
- 每一步的墙钟在头部行右端画成一段横条，右端对齐耗时数字。跨度是三个数量级，所以长度按对数映射；一列卡扫下来，左端参差就是这一轮的耗时分布。
- 每一轮以一条分隔线开始。轮次不编号：回退入口就在那张卡上，没有号需要用眼睛去对。
- 右栏九个等距堆叠的度量块按成本 · 进度 · 环境 · 产出分成四组，此前读起来像一份没填完的表单。

**窗口的灰阶回到产品自己的色相**

- 整套中性色此前落在色相 255–267，而产品唯一拥有的那个颜色在 75——相差 185 度，这就是它看着像别人家配色的原因。现在是 OKLCH，落在琥珀的色相上，彩度低到仍然是灰，明度逐一沿用被它替换的那个十六进制值。

**排队的行可以撤回**

- 一轮正在跑时打字，这行会排到下一个工具边界。此前没有任何办法取消：持久条目有 id 也有删除路由，但删除拒绝排队这一个状态，而前端把回执丢掉了——屏幕上那一行没有名字可以用来撤销。

**子代理的依赖边携带答案**

- `depends_on` 此前只排先后、不送内容，于是一对「先调研、再实现」的任务把同一份调研付了两次

releases.name: Reasonix Studio v2.5.0
releases.body:
远程工作区：一台通过 SSH 连接的机器，其上的文件夹与会话像本地的一样出现在侧边栏。自 2.4.0 起 41 个提交。

## 破坏性变更

- **思考档位按 endpoint 判定，不再按模型名**。中转端点不再被提供厂商专属档位（`max`、`xhigh`）；超出该 API 文档词表的档位降级到最深的标准档，而不是被拒绝。声明了 `supported_efforts` 的端点仍以自己的声明为准。此前一个中转的 deepseek-v4-flash 每轮返回 `field ReasoningEffort invalid, should be one of: low, medium, high, xhigh, none`，且按继续会重发同一设置，该轮无法自行恢复。

## 新增

**远程工作区**（侧边栏 › 主机）

- 主机是一个分区而不是前缀：同一台机器上的所有工作区共享一条 SSH 连接，链接断开时整个分区一起变灰。本地工作区不带标记，所以带标记本身就是信号；同样的标记出现在 pane 标签与面包屑上，因为命令落在焦点标签指向的那台机器上。
- 连接后的主机列出自己有什么：其上的文件夹与其中的会话，通过已在该机器上打开的 pane 读取，不另开连接、不另起进程。恢复一个远程会话与恢复本地会话是同一个动作。未连接的主机只保留一行，这一行就是连接按钮。
- 每个 pane 在远端开自己的 runtime。此前两个 pane 打开同一个远程工作区会共用一份对话记录——一份记录，两个写入者，两条流交错。
- 冷启动会在远端安装内核，安装按步骤逐条显示，而不是一个分不清「正在下载」与「卡住了」的转圈。
- **主机簿可以在窗口里编辑**（设置 › 主机），此前只能从 CLI 添加。主机簿属于使用者本人，不属于添加时恰好打开的那个文件夹。`~/.ssh/config` 里已有、主机簿里还没有的别名，可一键导入。
- **首次连接会停下来发问**：不在 known_hosts 中的机器弹出指纹确认，带口令的私钥弹出口令输入。指纹换行显示而不省略中段——中段被省略的指纹无法与任何东西比对；焦点默认落在「取消」上。
- **Windows 可以作为远程主机**。此前 SSH 之下的一切都假设 POSIX shell，现在收敛到一个接口：用哪个 shell、路径怎么拼写、进程怎么启动与再找到。已对真实 Windows 主机端到端验证：安装、启动、跨 SSH 会话存活、经转发访问 `/status` 与 `/tree`、停止。
- SSH agent 在 Windows 上通过 OpenSSH 服务固定名字的命名管道使用；`IdentitiesOnly` 的筛选此前整个在 `!windows` 编译标签内，现在三平台共用。
- 主机密钥变更、指纹被拒、凭据被拒各自带编

aiSummary.oneLiner: An optimized reasoning engine designed to enhance the analytical capabilities of DeepSeek models.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: DeepSeek-Reasonix is a specialized framework that significantly boosts the complex problem-solving abilities of DeepSeek language models. It addresses the limitations of standard inference by implementing advanced prompting strategies and multi-step reasoning architectures directly into the execution pipeline. The technical approach involves breaking down intricate queries into smaller, verifiable sub-tasks and utilizing self-reflection loops to correct errors before generating the final output. What sets this apart is its specific tuning for the DeepSeek model family, extracting maximum performance for logic, math, and coding tasks without requiring massive computational overhead. It transforms a standard LLM into a highly deliberate reasoning engine.
keyFeatures: Multi-Step Decomposition: automatically breaks complex problems into manageable sub-tasks for more accurate processing.
Self-Correction Loops: implements built-in reflection mechanisms where the model critiques and refines its own intermediate answers.
DeepSeek Optimization: specifically tuned to leverage the unique architectural traits and training distribution of DeepSeek models.
Traceable Logic Paths: outputs the intermediate reasoning steps, providing transparency into how the final answer was derived.
Lightweight Integration: provides a clean API that can be easily dropped into existing inference pipelines without heavy dependencies.

useCases.title: Complex Mathematical Solving
useCases.description: Researchers use the engine to tackle advanced math problems where standard one-shot prompting frequently fails.

useCases.title: Algorithmic Code Generation
useCases.description: Software developers deploy it to generate highly optimized algorithms by forcing the model to plan the logic before writing syntax.

useCases.title: Legal Document Analysis
useCases.description: Analysts utilize the traceable reasoning paths to verify the logic used when extracting clauses from dense legal contracts.

useCases.title: Automated QA Verification
useCases.description: QA teams integrate the self-correction loops to build more reliable automated testing scripts that adapt to dynamic UI changes.

aiSummary.whoIsItFor: This framework is targeted at AI researchers, developers, and data scientists who require high-reliability outputs for complex logical tasks. It requires familiarity with LLM prompting techniques and basic Python integration.
